/calendar.note: requireSession requires any signed-in identity (including super-admin); redirects church-context identities to /app/calendar and super-admin/control-context to /control. Signed-out -> /sign-in.

/control/[section].seedSource: not a DB id — static enum member from lib/control-plane.ts's controlPlaneSections (id list: overview|tenants|billing|support|demo-feedback). generateStaticParams excludes 'overview' (that id notFound()s here; overview lives at /control instead).

/controll.note: Typo-alias page, no session gate of its own — unconditional redirect(); destination enforces control-plane-only.

/give/[slug].note: Renders demo Grace Harbor giving data for any :slug when NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true; 404s otherwise. No real Stripe/production public_giving_pages lookup is wired yet (see the TODO comment in the page source).
/give/[slug].seedSource: not a DB lookup — app/give/[slug]/page.tsx's getGivingPageData() stub accepts any slug string and returns static Grace Harbor demo data ONLY when NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true; returns null (-> notFound(), a 404) otherwise. CI's e2e job sets NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true (.github/workflows/ci.yml); local runs must set it too or this page 404s for every slug.

/hq.note: Gated entirely by app/hq/layout.tsx, NOT by lib/auth's requireChurchSession/requireControlPlaneSession — it checks a raw Supabase auth session directly plus the current_user_role() Postgres RPC (supabase/migrations/20260713000000_hq.sql), which maps platform_admins -> 'admin', church_admin -> 'admin', pastor_elder/secretary/ministry_leader -> 'manager', and member_volunteer -> 'member' (or 'teacher' if the profile has a ccm_volunteer_assignments row with role='lead_teacher'). Only the mapped role 'member' is denied (redirect to /app). ACCESS-CONTROL INCONSISTENCY worth flagging: because this check is independent of lib/auth's appContext, super-admin (sarah) can open /app/hq even while in CONTROL context — unlike every other /app/* page, which requireChurchSession denies to super-admin outright. Also: a plain 'member' role person WITH a lead_teacher CCM assignment passes this gate (mapped to 'teacher', which is not 'member') — an edge case not covered by the current 6-identity fixture set.

/portal.note: getSession() is optional (no requireSession) — renders for signed-out visitors. Signed-in identities in a CHURCH app context get redirected onward (member -> /app/member; every other church role -> session.homePath). super-admin in CONTROL context is NOT redirected (isChurchAppContext is false for control) and sees the portal page rendered normally, same as signed-out.

/portal/children/checkin/[token].note: Token is an ephemeral per-session checkin_session_token on ccm_services, not seeded statically in supabase/seed.sql — cannot be deterministically fixtured. getPublicCcmSessionByToken() returns null for an unknown token and the page renders a graceful 'unavailable' state (verified: no throw). The sweep should assert that graceful state with a garbage token, not a happy path.

/portal/children/checkout/[token].note: Same token mechanism and graceful-degradation behavior as /portal/children/checkin/[token].

/portal/volunteer/confirm/[token].note: Token is volunteer_shifts.confirmation_token, generated per-shift and not seeded statically. getPublicVolunteerShiftByToken() returns null for an unknown/expired token (verified: no throw) and the page renders 'Invalid or Expired Link'. The sweep should assert that state with a garbage token.

/portal/volunteer/schedule/[token].note: Same confirmation_token mechanism as /portal/volunteer/confirm/[token]. getPublicVolunteerScheduleByToken() returns an empty array for an unknown token (verified: no throw) and the page renders 'No Upcoming Assignments' — that IS this route's graceful invalid-token state.

/sign-in.note: If already signed in, redirects to ?redirectTo (sanitized) UNLESS ?force=1 and the session lacks control-plane access (used to let a church-only identity switch to a control-plane account without first signing out).

/workspace.note: requireSession requires any signed-in identity, then redirect(session.homePath) — own homePath, not role-param-dependent.

/workspace/[role].note: requireSession only requires ANY signed-in identity, then unconditionally redirect(getRoleHomePath(:role)) — the redirect target depends on the :role URL param, NOT on the caller's own role, so e.g. a signed-in 'member' hitting /workspace/church-admin is redirected to /app/church-admin (which then itself denies them via requireChurchSession's own role check). Not a data leak, but worth the sweep knowing the redirect target varies by :role, not by identity.
/workspace/[role].seedSource: not a DB id — static enum member of lib/portal.ts's portalRoles (super-admin|church-admin|secretary|pastor|ministry-leader|member); an unrecognized value 404s (notFound()) before the session check even runs.
